title: 奥德赛 · 第01集：求婚者的狂宴
what_if: 奥德修斯失踪20年，宫殿沦为求婚者的酒池肉林；19岁的忒勒玛科斯在怒火与无力之间，第一次看清自己将继承的是什么。
target_feeling: 史诗压迫感 + 隐忍的愤怒 + 命运的冷光
visual_style: Mycenaean Greece 1200 BC: cyclopean masonry, rough timber pillars, crude bronze vessels, coarse undyed linen and animal hides; gritty realism, cinematic epic, chiaroscuro cinematic lighting, shot on 35mm lens, volumetric smoke, dark earthy low-saturation palette, film grain; reference: Troy (2004) texture, 300 dark oil-painting mood, The Northman primal rawness; no classical marble, no ornate temple architecture

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.identity_note: male 19, lean wiry build, short messy dark-brown hair, sharp jaw, intense dark eyes; rough undyed wool tunic with frayed hem, bare arms, thin bronze armband on left wrist; do-not-change: face, short dark-brown hair, undyed wool tunic

characters.name: Penelope
characters.identity_note: female 34, oval face, long dark hair in a loose low braid, tall stoic figure; simple undyed pale greyish-white wool chiton, plain bronze torc; do-not-change: face, loose low braid, pale chiton

characters.name: Antinous
characters.identity_note: male 32, rugged stocky build, thick oiled dark beard, slicked-back black hair; heavy bronze-age jewelry: thick bronze torc and big ring; garish dyed-red tunic over fur; do-not-change: face, oiled beard, red tunic + bronze torc

scenes.name: Mycenaean Megaron (great hall)
scenes.description: massive interior palace hall: cyclopean stone walls, thick rough-hewn wooden pillars, central hearth pit, animal-skin floor, drifting smoke haze, night
scenes.light_baseline: key: central hearth fire (warm orange), no fill, volumetric smoke, deep shadows

shots.continuity_handoff: Open on the smoky great hall wide; the suitors' chaos is the baseline Telemachus will watch in the next shot; hearth + pillars + skins anchor the space for the whole episode.

char_positions.求婚者们(群演): dozens of rough men sprawling on animal skins across the floor, midground

shots.lighting_baseline: key: central hearth fire warm orange; volumetric smoke; deep black shadows on stone
shots.shot_description: Wide shot, slow push in. The smoky, dimly lit ancient Greek Megaron great hall. Mycenaean architecture with thick wooden pillars and rough stone walls. Dozens of arrogant men are feasting chaotically, sprawling on animal skins. Firelight from the central hearth casts long, dramatic shadows.

per_second.action: camera opens inside the smoky great hall; haze drifts across the frame; fire flicker ripples on the stone wall
per_second.spatial: hearth center, wooden pillars at left and right, animal skins on the floor
per_second.audio: low roar of the fire + distant chaotic chatter

per_second.action: suitors sprawl on skins: one raises a bronze goblet, another tosses a bone, others brawl-laugh over meat
per_second.spatial: figures scattered across the midground, hearth light central
per_second.audio: raucous laughter + bronze cup clink + meat sizzling

per_second.action: pillar shadows loom across the smoke; a heavy suitor sprawls center-frame, drunk on wine
per_second.spatial: foreground pillar edge at frame-left, hearth glow center
per_second.audio: laughter swells, fire crackle close
per_second.handoff: holds wide chaos for the hard cut to the greedy close-up

per_second.action: chaos sustains: cups raised, meat torn, smoke thickens; the fire swells once
per_second.spatial: same wide composition, hearth center
per_second.audio: hall roar steady, one deep guffaw

per_second.action: chaos sustains; embers rise through the haze
per_second.spatial: same wide composition
per_second.audio: fire crackle + low roar

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT from the wide hall to Antinous's greedy face; same firelight world (stone wall + hearth glow); his spilled wine is the greed motif that Telemachus watches in the next shot.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: hearth fire warm orange from front-left; rim light on the spilled wine; deep shadow behind
shots.shot_description: Close up, slow motion. A rugged, bearded ancient Greek suitor wearing bronze-age jewelry laughs maliciously, spilling dark red wine from a crude bronze goblet; greasy roasted meat on the wooden table.

per_second.action: Antinous leans into frame: oiled beard, thick bronze torc, big ring; he raises the crude bronze goblet, grin wide
per_second.spatial: his face center, dark stone wall behind, fire glow front-left
per_second.audio: his malicious laugh + wine sloshing in the cup
per_second.handoff: goblet raised, wine at the rim

per_second.action: he tilts the goblet; dark red wine spills over the bronze lip onto the wooden table; grease glints on the roasted meat
per_second.camera: hold tight close, slight push toward the spill
per_second.spatial: wine stream center-bottom, rim light on the droplets
per_second.audio: wine splash SFX + his laugh + distant hall roar
per_second.handoff: end on the spilled wine - greed motif locked

per_second.action: he laughs again, wiping wine from his beard with his thumb
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: his laugh + distant roar

per_second.action: he tips the cup once more, more wine spills; the meat glints in firelight
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: wine spill + low roar

per_second.action: he grins at camera, wine on his beard
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: his low chuckle

references.retention_note: retain face, oiled beard, red tunic + bronze torc of Antinous across the whole shot
references.description: the rugged bearded suitor in the dyed-red tunic with thick bronze torc

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT to Telemachus in the pillar shadow; same hall (stone wall + hearth glow visible), his eye-line lands on the suitors; his clenched fists set up his mother's grief in the final shot.

char_positions.Telemachus: left third, midground, standing in the pillar shadow, facing frame-right

shots.lighting_baseline: key: hearth fire raking from the right, half his face lit (chiaroscuro); left half in deep shadow
shots.shot_description: Medium shot, slow tracking camera. Young Telemachus stands in the shadows of a massive stone pillar, watching the chaotic suitors; he wears a rough woven ancient tunic; his eyes are filled with suppressed anger and tears, fists clenched; dramatic side lighting illuminates half his face.

per_second.action: Telemachus stands still in the pillar's shadow, jaw tight; hearth glow rakes the right half of his face
per_second.spatial: pillar shadow at frame-left, Telemachus left third, fire glow from the right
per_second.audio: his controlled breathing + faint distant laughter

per_second.action: his fists clench at his sides; his eyes track a suitor off-frame, teeth grit
per_second.camera: slow tracking continues, slight push toward his eyes
per_second.spatial: fists lower third, eye-line toward frame-right
per_second.audio: breath-held tension, the hall roar pushed far away

per_second.action: he swallows hard; one fist tightens; smoke drifts past his silhouette
per_second.spatial: his face center-left, shadowed stone wall behind
per_second.audio: hall roar fades to a distant murmur
per_second.handoff: holds his gaze for the hard cut up to Penelope

per_second.action: he watches the off-frame suitors; a single ember falls across the frame
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: distant murmur + faint ember hiss

per_second.action: his jaw works; the fire swells, his half-lit face flares
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: fire swell + low murmur

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.retention_note: retain face, short dark-brown hair, undyed wool tunic of Telemachus across the whole shot
references.description: the young prince in the rough undyed tunic with thin bronze armband

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT up to the wooden balcony: cold moonlight world against the warm firelight below; Penelope's silhouetted grief is the closing image of the episode.

char_positions.Penelope: top center, standing at the rail, silhouetted against the moonlight

shots.lighting_baseline: key: pale cold moonlight from above; warm violent firelight glow from below; soft ethereal contrast
shots.shot_description: Low angle shot looking up at a rough wooden balcony. Queen Penelope stands silhouetted against pale moonlight, looking down at the fiery chaos below with an expression of profound grief and resilience.

per_second.action: camera looks up the rough stone wall to the wooden balcony; Penelope stands at the rail, pale moonlight halos behind her
per_second.spatial: stone wall bottom, wooden balcony top third, moonlight behind her
per_second.audio: night wind + very distant fire below
per_second.handoff: her silhouette resolves in the moonlight

per_second.action: she looks down over the rail; warm firelight from the hall tints the bottom of the frame; she is still against the chaos
per_second.camera: hold low angle on her silhouette
per_second.spatial: her silhouette top center, fire glow at frame bottom
per_second.audio: heavy ambient bed in: low wind + distant cracking fire + a lone low drone
per_second.handoff: end on her silent grief - episode closes

per_second.action: the fire below swells, her silhouette edges flare warm; she does not move
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: low drone + distant roar

per_second.action: her braid stirs in the wind; the moonlight steadies
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: wind + low drone

per_second.action: she holds her stillness; the frame breathes with smoke and light
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: heavy ambient sustains
